spawn_spec.prompt:
TASK: Connect the orphaned IPC wrappers to UI, remote device management first.
CONTEXT: Seven IPC wrappers have zero UI callers: listRemoteDevices, revokeRemoteDevice, getTailscaleStatus (in ui/src/lib/tauri.ts) and setBrowserZoom, focusBrowser, getBrowserState, listBrowsers (in ui/src/lib/browserTauri.ts). The backend commands all exist (43/43 wrapper coverage). A previous lane just added Appearance/Quick Commands/Browser sections to ui/src/components/SettingsDialog.tsx - read the CURRENT file and extend it, do not regress.
DELIVERABLE: (1) Remote settings section: list paired devices via listRemoteDevices with a per-device Revoke button calling revokeRemoteDevice (with a confirm step) and a Tailscale status line via getTailscaleStatus. (2) Browser settings section: a zoom control wired to setBrowserZoom. (3) focusBrowser / getBrowserState / listBrowsers: wire each where it naturally fits (e.g. browser toolbar or Browser section); if a wrapper genuinely has no sensible UI home, leave it unwired and say why in the report.
SCOPE: ui/src/components/SettingsDialog.tsx + ui/src/components/SettingsDialog.test.tsx, optionally ui/src/components/BrowserToolbar.tsx + its test, ui/src/remote/* if needed. Do NOT change src-tauri backend or the tauri.ts/browserTauri.ts wrapper signatures. OUT OF SCOPE: everything else.
VERIFY: tests RED then GREEN (remote section renders mocked devices and calls revokeRemoteDevice on click; zoom control calls setBrowserZoom); full 'bun run test' green; tsc clean.
STOP WHEN: wrappers wired or explicitly justified, tests RED->GREEN, suite green, tsc clean, report returned.

final_response:
### Intent & Deliverable Summary
Connected all seven orphaned IPC wrappers (`listRemoteDevices`, `revokeRemoteDevice`, `getTailscaleStatus`, `setBrowserZoom`, `focusBrowser`, `getBrowserState`, `listBrowsers`) to frontend UI components and added test coverage.

---

### Wrapper UI Wiring

| Wrapper | UI Surface | Interaction / Behavior |
|---|---|---|
| `listRemoteDevices` | `SettingsDialog.tsx` (`RemoteAccessSettings`) | Queries and renders paired remote devices (name, permissions, last seen timestamp, revocation status) on load, gateway toggle, and revocation. |
| `revokeRemoteDevice` | `SettingsDialog.tsx` (`RemoteAccessSettings`) | Per-device Revoke button with inline confirmation step ("Confirm Revoke" / "Cancel") calling `revokeRemoteDevice(deviceId)`. |
| `getTailscaleStatus` | `SettingsDialog.tsx` (`RemoteAccessSettings`) | Displays live Tailscale status line (Running with tailnet name, Disconnected, or Not Installed, along with Self-DNS). |
| `setBrowserZoom` | `SettingsDialog.tsx` (`BrowserSettings`) & `BrowserToolbar.tsx` | Invoked on changing default zoom level in Browser Settings across active browsers, and via Zoom In / Zoom Out toolbar buttons in `BrowserToolbar`. |
| `focusBrowser` | `SettingsDialog.tsx` (`BrowserSettings`) & `BrowserToolbar.tsx` | Focus button per active browser session in Settings and "Focus webview" target button in `BrowserToolbar`. |
| `getBrowserState` | `BrowserToolbar.tsx` | "Sync browser state" button on `BrowserToolbar` querying live webview state and syncing current URL. |
| `listBrowsers` | `SettingsDialog.tsx` (`BrowserSettings`) | Lists active browser sessions in Browser Settings and discovers active webviews to apply zoom updates. |
